name: Joachim Meyerhoff
bio: Joachim Meyerhoff is a German actor, director, and writer. After more than 13 years at the Burgtheater in Vienna, Meyerhoff moved to the Schaubühne in Berlin in 2019.

credits.title: Fatherland
credits.overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

credits.title: Oh, This Unspeakable Void
credits.overview: At the age of 20, Joachim is unexpectedly accepted into the renowned acting school in Munich and moves into the villa with his grandparents, Inge and Hermann. credits.title: Sörensen Catches Fire
credits.overview: Inspector Sörensen has finally retreated to the Frisian province, but he still has to contend with his own inner demons. Loneliness, insomnia and inner restlessness plague him, and although he does everything he can to stop taking his medication for the anxiety disorder, he remains trapped in his psychological torment.
